newsitem.title: INDIA: India's external sector strong, says RBI governor.
newsitem.headline: India's external sector strong, says RBI governor.

text.p: India's external sector continued to be strong, the governor of central bank Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Friday.
"The external sector remains strong," he told a meeting of Indian Engineering Export Promotion Council (EEPC).
"It is estimated that the current account deficit for 1996/97 was a little over one percent of the GDP," he said.
He said the capital account of India's balance of payments has also undergone significant changes during the last four years.
"Foreign direct investment and portfolio investment today finance about 50 percent of our total financing requirements."

"It is this strengthening of balance of payments which has enabled India to build up a fairly sizeable level of reserves. As of a recent date, the foreign currency assets of the RBI have exceeded $26 billion," the governor said.
